title: Show age of right-now summary and avoid stale summaries
description:
Problem: the auto-generated right_now_summary can be stale and misleading. Example observed in Papyrus: an epic shown as "awaits the M0 spike" after that work had shipped. kbs show prints the summary near the top (verified: kbs show prints a "Right now:" line directly after Labels, before Description).

Acceptance (any one, preferably the first two together):
- Show the summary age (right_now_updated_at) next to it, with a stale marker when older than the issue's last status change or comment.
- Regenerate the summary on status change.
- Omit it from kbs show by default (available via a flag); kbs show --raw already bypasses interception, so define the relationship.
- Gherkin scenario: close an issue and confirm show does not present a pre-close summary as current.
right_now_summary: The team is adding summary timestamps and stale markers to prevent misleading right-now summaries.
